texts: I lived years in a daze of routine, bitter as a bitter gourd, until one morning I suddenly saw my life clearly, as if an inner eye had opened.
The bitter gourd stirs from its long slumber, and the inner eye opens to the dawn within.
Give me a doha about someone sleeping in the dream of daily life, bitter as a bitter gourd in heart, who is gently shaken awake and sees with an inner eye that had been closed for years.
bitter gourd, inner eye opens
doha w bitter gourd: waking up from the sleep of life
One ordinary Tuesday it hit me that I had been living half-asleep for decades, and something inside me finally opened its eyes.
inner eye opens
I'd like a doha about the moment a person wakes from the long sleep of not-knowing into a bright, quiet awareness of himself and the world, as if an inner eye had at last been opened.
doha on waking up spiritually
The sleeper stirs; the inner eye, closed through countless nights, parts its lids to the dawn.
doha: my tongue woke up and spoke from the heart, spiritual awakening vibes
The tongue that spoke in slumber now speaks from the waking heart, and the inner eye smiles.
tongue, awakened
For years I spoke without thinking, like a sleepwalker, then one day a sudden awareness opened in me and I heard my own tongue for the first time.
Write a doha about a person whose tongue has chattered in sleep for years and who at last wakes up inwardly, speaking from a new awareness with an eye opened within.
Craft a doha about waking from the sleep of not-knowing and discovering that the philosopher's stone one searched the world for was always inside, now seen by the newly opened inner eye.
philosopher's stone, awakening
I chased the philosopher's stone in a dozen ways, and then one quiet morning I woke up inside and saw that what I sought was what was looking.
doha w philosopher's stone: waking up inside
The sleeper sought the philosopher's stone afar; the waking found it where the inner eye opened.
On the touchstone of waking, the sleeper's dreams fall away, and the inner eye sees what is.
touchstone, awakening
Please make a doha about the moment of waking when the touchstone of awareness shows every dream of the sleeping mind for what it was, and the inner eye opens on what is real.
doha w touchstone: waking up tests everything
After a crisis tested me like a touchstone, I woke up from my long daze and saw my life with new, wide-open eyes inside.
doha w scales: when i woke up inside everything got weighed right
scales, inner awakening
Write a doha about waking from the sleep of the mind and seeing with the inner eye how the scales of one's life have been tilted by dreaming, and how awareness restores the balance.
In sleep the scales hung crooked; at waking, the inner eye sets them level.
I wasn't aware how lopsided my life had become until a sudden inner waking showed me, as if someone had put me on the scales.
The sleeper counts gold in dreams; the waker finds the one treasure the inner eye opens to.
gold, waking within
I need a doha about someone who chased gold all his life as if in a dream, and who wakes at last, opening the inner eye to a wealth that no dream could have promised.
doha w gold: chased it in my sleep, now i woke up
I spent my youth chasing gold, and it was only when I woke up one dawn to a stillness inside that I saw what I had been missing.
waking from sleep
doha about waking up inside, like a new awareness
A slow light touches the sleeping soul, and the inner eye rises to meet it.
A single quiet moment on a train made me suddenly aware of my own awareness, as if I had been asleep my whole life.

Can you put together a doha for someone who feels the first stirring of awakening, the gentle rising of an inner eye, and asks how the long sleep of the mind finally breaks open to a clearer and brighter day.
The churn of the mind turns through the night, and the cleric's dreams dissolve; at dawn the inner eye is awake.
churn, cleric, awakening
A cleric I know says the churn of his thoughts quieted one night, and he woke inwardly as from a lifelong dream; I'd like a doha on such waking.
doha w churn + cleric: waking up inside
Write a doha about a cleric whose mind churned in restless dreams for years until a sudden inner waking opened his eye within, and the long sleep of the heart came to its end.
eye within opens
doha on wakin up from the dream of life
The dream thins like morning mist, and the one who dreamed discovers he is awake.
After my father's passing I suddenly felt awake for the first time, as if the long dream of my days had cleared.
Give me a doha about the gentle waking from the long dream we call ordinary life into a calm, bright awareness that sees things as they are, with the inner eye wide open at last.
palanquin, awakening
I'd like a doha about a man carried through life in a palanquin, half asleep to everything around him, who suddenly wakes up inside and sees with an inner eye how the world and he himself are.
doha w palanquin: i got carried thru life asleep, now im awake
Carried in the palanquin of habit, the soul slept; now the inner eye awakens and steps down.
Life carried me along in comfort like a palanquin for decades, until one day I woke to myself and asked who was inside.
The washerman rinses at midnight beneath the stars, and the sleeper's soul awakens by that quiet toil.
doha w washerman n stars: waking up at night
I woke before dawn and watched a washerman at work under the stars, and something inside me stirred awake in the stillness.
washerman, stars, awakening
Write a doha about a person who, watching a washerman toil quietly beneath the stars at night, feels the long sleep of his own mind break and the inner eye open to a new awareness.
diamond, blind man, awakening
Craft a doha about a blind man who finds a diamond and wakes inwardly, for the inner eye opens even where the outer one is closed, and the long sleep of the mind comes to an end.
A blind man I know seemed more awake inside than anyone I have met, like he held a diamond of awareness in his chest; can I have a doha on that?
doha w diamond + blind man: eyes closed but inner eye open
Though his outer eyes are closed, the blind man's inner eye shines like a diamond awake.
waking up
Please write a doha about the slow, quiet waking of the soul from its sleep of habit, when the inner eye opens and the person sees with new clarity everything that had always been before him.
Soft is the first light of the waking soul, and gentle the lifting of its lids.
doha on spiritual awakening, keep it simple
There was no thunder or sign, just an ordinary afternoon when I realized I was truly awake for the first time in my life.
I used to move through my days on autopilot, and then something small broke the trance, and now I feel awake in a way I can't describe.
the inner eye opened
Please make a doha about the soul's sleep ending without any noise, only a quiet awareness rising like the morning, until the inner eye is fully open and nothing remains of the long dream.
No trumpet sounds; the sleeper simply wakes, and the world is new.
doha about suddenly waking inside, pls
doha w touchstone: awakening tests who u really are
On the touchstone of the waking hour, the sleeper's pretensions crumble and the inner eye alone remains.
touchstone, inner waking
A hard conversation tested me like a touchstone, and afterward I felt awake inside for the first time in years.
Write a doha about the hour of awakening, when the touchstone of awareness proves what is real in a person and the long sleep of the mind gives way to an opened inner eye.
jaggery, awakening
The sweetness of jaggery is nothing to the sweetness of waking from the long night of the mind.
I need a doha about someone who tasted jaggery in sleep for years, thinking it the sweetest thing, until he woke inwardly and found a sweetness in awareness that no dream could offer.
doha w jaggery: waking up is sweeter than any treat
I used to comfort myself with sweet treats and distractions, like jaggery, until I woke up inside and found real peace.
doha w peacock n yogi: waking up inside is the real dance
A yogi I met told me the day he woke up inside, it felt like a peacock spreading its feathers within, and I'd love a doha on that.
peacock, yogi, awakening
Can you put together a doha about a yogi who wakes from the long sleep of the mind and feels his heart dance like a peacock, as the inner eye opens to a joy that outer things can never give.
The yogi wakes within, and the peacock of his heart spreads its colors to the unseen dawn.
Open, O inward eye; the night was long, and the sleeper has dreamt enough.
After decades of numbness, a single breath one morning felt like waking up, and I want a doha about that breath.
Write a doha about the mind that has slept through the busy years of life and now rises into awareness, finding that the inner eye was only waiting to be opened by a gentle morning.
waking inwardly
doha pls abt a soul waking up
Give me a doha about the heron that stands still as if asleep and yet is wide awake within, teaching that the awakening of the inner eye does not need motion or noise.
heron, inner awakening
Still as a dreamer stands the heron, yet within, the eye is open wide.
doha w heron: looks asleep but awake inside
I watched a heron stand motionless for an hour, and I realized I had been moving constantly without ever being awake.
I had been caught in a net of worries for so long, like a sleeper in a dream, until a sudden waking showed me I could simply step out.
doha w net: waking up and seeing u were stuck in a net of dreams
The net was woven of sleep; at waking, the inner eye sees through it and the sleeper walks free.
I'd like a doha about a soul sleeping in a net of desire and fear, who wakes and with the inner eye sees that the net was never real, and walks freely out into daylight.
net, awakening
I'd like a doha for those who are in the early stage of awakening, when the inner eye has just opened, saying that the world looks the same but the seer has changed, and nothing will be as before.
After my retreat the world looked the same, but I felt as though I had woken from a long dream and every face had become clearer.
eye opened inside
doha on the first days after waking spiritually
The same road, the same sky, but the walker has woken, and all is new.
In the deep of the sleeping soul lies a pearl; the waking eye within brings it to the light.
pearl, awakening
Write a doha about the pearl that sleeps in the depths of the self until awakening comes, the inner eye opens, and the person finds what had always been within his own heart.
doha w pearl: waking up and finding it inside
I searched the world for happiness, and when I woke up inside, I found it lying within me like a pearl.
As the oyster opens to the dawn and gives up its pearl, the sleeping soul opens its inner eye.
pearl, soul wakes
doha: pearl opens w the dawn, like waking up inside
Craft a doha about the soul that wakes like an oyster opening at dawn to show a pearl, and the inner eye that sees what the long sleep of the mind had kept hidden.
My grandmother kept a pearl from her mother, and she says it taught her to wait for the awakening of the heart as the oyster waits for dawn.
beggar, sun, awakening
doha w beggar + sun: he woke up inside at sunrise
Please make a doha about a beggar who sat awake at sunrise and felt the inner eye open, and who knew then that the sun within was greater than any wealth that sleep had denied him.
At sunrise the beggar wakes, and a second sun rises in the opened eye of the heart.
Watching a beggar greet the morning sun with a calm face, I felt a sudden awakening of my own, as if I had been asleep to what matters.
I started slowing down like a tortoise withdrawing into itself, and out of that stillness a new awareness woke up in me.
doha w tortoise: slow n quiet and then i woke up inside
tortoise, inner awakening
Write a doha about the tortoise that draws into silence and wakes to a new awareness, showing that the inner eye opens in stillness rather than in the noise of the world.
In the tortoise's silence the sleeper wakes, and the inner eye opens to its own light.
I remember the instant it happened: a quiet shift, like coming up from deep water, and suddenly everything felt real and close.
I need a doha about the soul rising from the depths of sleep into a vivid, calm awareness, when the inner eye opens and ordinary things appear fresh as if seen for the first time.
the soul wakes
From the deep of slumber the soul ascends, and the inner eye sees the morning.
doha about suddenly feeling awake in life
pls a doha on awakening from the sleep of the mind
Please write a doha for a friend who has just begun to wake from the sleep of old habits, telling him that the inner eye, once open, never fully closes again, and that dawn is already here.
I stopped scrolling one night, sat in the dark, and felt as if a switch had flipped inside me and I was awake.
Dawn has touched the sleeper's lids; the eye within is opening.
the awakening begins

Can you put together a doha about the awakening that comes when life itself becomes a touchstone, testing the sleeper until he wakes with an inner eye, and sees which of his dreams were real and which were not.
Life is the touchstone and the sleeper wakes at its touch; the inner eye alone survives the test.
doha w touchstone: wake up call
A health scare tested me like a touchstone, and I woke up inside, finally aware of what I had been sleeping through.
touchstone, awakening
ocean, lock, awakening
doha w ocean n lock: waking up unlocks the inner ocean
I felt like a lock had finally opened inside me, and what flowed out was a vast calm like an ocean; I'd love a doha on that.
The lock of slumber falls open, and the ocean of the waking self rolls in.
Write a doha about a soul asleep behind a lock, who wakes and finds the lock opened by awareness itself, the inner eye gazing out upon an ocean of calm that had always been there.
Give me a doha about the parrot that repeats words in its sleep and the chakor bird that waits wide awake for what it loves, teaching that the awakening of the inner eye is more than parroting.
I spent years repeating phrases like a parrot, until one morning I woke to a longing as pure as a chakor bird's, and I felt truly awake.
doha w parrot + chakor bird: waking up from repeating to real longing
parrot, chakor bird, awakening
The parrot speaks in sleep; the chakor bird keeps vigil; the waking soul opens its inner eye.
One day I stopped living by reflex and noticed everything, as if I had been asleep for forty years and someone had gently called my name.
A gentle call, and the sleeper opens the eye within; the dream was only a long night.
doha on a soft spiritual awakening
waking, inner eye
I'd like a doha about the soft call that awakens the soul from its long sleep, not with fear or force but with a gentle light, until the inner eye opens and the sleeper smiles at the dawn.
beggar, awakening
doha: beggar wakes up inside n becomes rich
Write a doha about a beggar who wakes inwardly one morning and finds that the inner eye has opened to a wealth no king could have, while the world still sees him as poor.
A beggar at our corner smiled one morning with a look so awake that I felt my own sleep lift just from seeing him.
The beggar wakes, the inner eye opens, and the poorest man becomes the richest at dawn.

Craft a doha about a weaver at his weaver's loom at dawn who feels the dew and wakes inwardly, as the inner eye opens and the long dream of weaving the patterns of the world dissolves into a clear morning.
Dew on the weaver's loom, and the weaver wakes; the inner eye opens as the day begins.
dew, weaver's loom, waking
doha w dew + weaver's loom: waking at dawn
My uncle told me he awoke inside one dawn while working at his weaver's loom with dew on the window, and his life changed; can I get a doha?
the eye within
When the soul awakens, even the old lane looks new.
doha on waking up, short
Sometimes I feel the old sleepiness dropping away and a freshness rising, as if I had just opened my eyes inside.
Please make a doha about the quiet joy of awakening when the sleep of the mind lifts, the inner eye opens, and a person looks at old things with a gentle new wonder.
one-string lute, awakening
Write a doha about a singer whose one-string lute plays a single note at dawn that wakes his inner eye, so that the sleeper in him rises and sees the world newly lit.
One note upon the one-string lute, and the sleeping soul opens its inner eye.
A street musician with a one-string lute played one note at dawn, and I felt something inside me wake up, as if I had been asleep for ages.
doha w one-string lute: one note wakes u up inside
doha w moneylender + palanquin: rich guy woke up inside
The moneylender leaves his counting, the palanquin waits empty; the inner eye has opened to the dawn.
moneylender, palanquin, waking
I need a doha about a moneylender carried everywhere in a palanquin, who one day wakes from the dream of wealth and sees with an inner eye how little all his counting had given him.
My wealthy uncle, a moneylender who rode everywhere in a palanquin-like car, woke up one day inside and gave it all up for quiet; I want a doha on it.
Can you put together a doha about a person watching a single leaf fall and suddenly waking inside, the inner eye opening as the long dream of the mind breaks in that moment of simple seeing.
A leaf falls, and the sleeper wakes; the inner eye sees the whole of life in that small turning.
doha w leaf: it fell n i woke up
leaf, sudden awakening
I watched a single leaf float down on a gray morning, and I woke up inside as if someone had called my name.
doha on slowly waking spiritually
waking from the dream
Compose a doha about the long road from sleep to awareness, when each small realization opens the inner eye a little more, until the whole dream of the old self fades into a bright and clear day.
My awakening wasn't dramatic; it was a hundred small noticings over years until I realized I was truly awake.
Little by little the lids of the soul lift, and the long night yields to day.
The lotus wakes from muddy sleep and opens to dawn; the sleeper in the sand rises and opens the inner eye.
doha w lotus + sand: waking up like a lotus opening
Give me a doha about the soul that sleeps buried in the sand and wakes like a lotus opening at dawn, its inner eye turned toward a light that had always been waiting.
I felt buried in the sand of daily life for years, and then something in me opened like a lotus in the morning; doha for that?
lotus, sand, awakening
I used to chase bright distractions like a moth, as blind as a blind man to myself, until a sudden waking opened something inside.
I'd like a doha about a moth circling bright things and a blind man groping in the dark, both asleep to themselves, until the inner eye opens and they see the light was within.
moth, blind man, awakening
doha w moth + blind man: sleepwalkers wake up inside
The moth chases, the blind man gropes; both sleep until the inner eye opens within.
I was addicted to little sweet comforts, like jaggery to a child, until I woke up one dawn and found something deeper.
jaggery, waking
Sweeter than jaggery is the first taste of waking, when the inner eye opens at dawn.
Write a doha about someone who spent life chewing on the jaggery of small pleasures in a half-sleep, and who finally wakes with an inner eye to a sweetness that lasts.
doha w jaggery: waking up beats little pleasures
I felt caught in a net of habits and carried like a river along its course, until one dawn I woke up and saw I could step out.
net, river, awakening
doha w net + river: waking up from the current of habit
Craft a doha about a person caught in a net while the river of life carries him half-asleep, until awakening opens his inner eye and he sees that the net was only a dream.
The river carries the sleeper in its net; at waking, the inner eye cuts through and he stands on the bank.
O sleeper, the night has ended; the eye within has opened, and the day is yours.
Please make a doha about the first morning after the long sleep of the mind, when the inner eye is open and the soul looks out at a world that is the same and yet utterly new.
awakening dawns
doha pls: waking from the sleep of the soul
The morning after a long night of reflection, I felt new, as if I had left an old dream behind.
After I lost everything and was left with only ash, I woke up inside and felt strangely awake and free; I'd like a doha about that.
ash, awakening
doha w ash: losing everything woke me up inside
Write a doha about the awakening that comes when everything is reduced to ash, and the sleeper, stripped of dreams, opens the inner eye and finds a light that nothing could burn.
From the ash of old dreams the waking soul rises, eye within opened wide.
I need a doha about a blind man sitting outside the temple who wakes within and sees with an inner eye what the sighted worshippers inside have not yet seen.
doha w blind man + temple: the blind man woke up inside
A blind man sits outside our temple each day, and seems far more awake than the worshippers inside; doha on that?
The blind man sits by the temple and wakes within; the sighted sleep inside while his inner eye opens.
blind man, temple, awakening
Can you put together a doha about a fly buzzing round a sleeper's face who stirs him not, until a deeper awakening comes from within, opening the inner eye and ending the long sleep of the mind.
A fly kept buzzing around me as I dozed on a train, and then I woke up fully and realized it was a metaphor for my whole life.
A fly may buzz about the sleeper, but only the inner dawn can wake him.
fly, awakening
doha w fly: small stuff doesnt wake u, inner dawn does
Write a doha about how a thorn in the foot can sometimes wake a sleepwalker, showing that even pain may be the call that opens the inner eye and ends the long sleep of the mind.
A hard time pricked me like a thorn, and instead of breaking me it woke me up inside; I'd love a doha on that.
thorn, awakening
doha w thorn: pain woke me up spiritually
The thorn pricks, the sleeper stirs, and the inner eye opens to a new day.
awake at last
doha about being finally awake inside
Give me a doha for the day when the soul finally wakes, in which the inner eye opens, the long dream of the self dissolves, and a calm brightness fills the mind like the first light of morning.
For years I felt I was living someone else's dream, and now I finally feel awake and myself.
Awake at last, the soul laughs softly at the dream it left behind.
the inner eye
I used to sleepwalk through everything, but lately I notice each moment, as if my inner eyes have finally opened.
What the dreamer called the world, the waker sees as a morning mist.
doha on spiritual awakening
I'd like a doha about the quiet miracle of awakening, when the sleeper of the mind opens his inner eye and finds the whole world, and himself, lit with a steady clarity that was always there.
